_comment: The 7 playable keys. The piano FBX is one FUSED mesh — these are the invisible hitboxes + visible key-caps faked on top of it. All positions are LOCAL to the piano group (x = across the keyboard, y = up, z = toward the player). Nudge x/y/z per key to line up with the real model's key texture once it's in the scene. capSize/hitboxSize are metres.
